Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick’s masterful psychological terror set in an isolated hotel. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A chilling family drama that escalates into supernatural dread. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart blend of horror and social commentary that keeps you on edge. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Suspense built around silence—perfect for a tense, atmospheric night. |
| 5 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A well‑crafted haunted‑house story grounded in “real” paranormal investigations. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A unique premise where a curse is passed through intimate encounters. |
| 7 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror that turns a Swedish festival into a nightmare. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood. |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | A modern retelling of the Japanese classic that still feels fresh. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Low‑budget found‑footage style that delivers genuine chills. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you prefer psychological dread, supernatural scares, or a mix of both!
